era: 现代教育时代（1890年四川巴中私塾先生之家—保宁府华英学堂—成都辅仁学堂—香港圣保罗书院（拒改入英籍而弃奖学金）—美国奥伯林学院→耶鲁大学（1918毕业）—法国战场华工青年会识字班主任（1918-1919，'苦力'教育的起点）—普林斯顿大学历史学硕士（1920）—归国任中华基督教青年会全国协会平民教育科主任—长沙烟台杭州嘉兴扫盲实验（1922起）—与朱其慧、陶行知等发起中华平民教育促进会（1923，任总干事）—定县实验（1926选点、1929举家迁入，'博士下乡'）—主编《平民千字课》、创办《民间》周刊—抗战期间创建中国乡村建设育才院（1940，重庆璧山）—战后赴菲律宾及亚非拉推广乡村改造（IIRR 国际乡村改造学院，1960）—1990年病逝纽约：巴中—成都—香港—耶鲁—法国华工营—定县—璧山—马尼拉—纽约）
school: 平民教育家 + 乡村建设运动奠基人（定县实验）+ 中华平民教育促进会总干事 + '四大教育/三大方式'体系发明人 + 国际平民教育运动领袖（'世界平民教育之父'）
courtesy_name: 原名晏兴复，字阳初（'旭日之初'，其父所赐）/ 詹姆斯·晏（Y. C. James Yen，英语世界通称）/ '平民教育之父'（尊称，非时称）
pseudonym: 以本名行世；在法国华工营以青年会干事身份编辑《驻法华工周报》（Tiny Times），署名不显；其理论多见于平教会公报、《民间》周刊社论与国际演讲（1943年'现代世界最具革命性贡献十大伟人'受奖词等）
historical_significance: 晏阳初（1890-1990），四川巴中人，中国平民教育与乡村建设运动的开创者。一战期间在法国华工营教识字，发现'苦力'的智力与尊严，立下'除文盲、作新民'之志。1920年归国后先在长沙、烟台等城市做扫盲实验（长沙三日招得1900人），首创《平民千字课》用六百常用字四个月完成识字；1923年与朱其慧、陶行知等创立中华平民教育促进会；1926年选定河北定县为实验县，1929年举家迁入，与数百位归国博士同住乡村，开展世界史上罕见的'博士下乡'实验。他诊断中国农民的'四大病'——愚、贫、弱、私，对症发明'四大教育'（文艺教育攻愚、生计教育治贫、卫生教育扶弱、公民教育克私）与'三大方式'（学校式、社会式、家庭式），把教育从课本扩展为县政、经济、卫生、自治的整体改造系统。定县实验产出平校毕业生数十万、表证农家、保健院制度与改良猪棉等实绩，其'县单位实验-研究-训练-推广'四位一体成为后来国际发展学的社区综合发展模型前身。1943年与爱因斯坦、杜威等同获哥白尼诞辰400周年纪念'现代世界最具革命性贡献十大伟人'。战后转向国际：在菲律宾创建国际乡村改造学院（IIRR），把定县方法输出到亚非拉数十国，被尊为'世界平民教育之父'，任联合国教科文组织特别顾问。他毕生坚持'民为邦本，本固邦宁'的民本信念与'最大的学习动力来自需要'的教育哲学，是中国经验大规模逆向输出西方主导的发展学领域的第一人。
unique_thinking: 晏阳初的独特贡献是把'扫盲'升级为'社会整体改造的操作系统'，并坚持实验先于理论：其一，'3C'精神底座——孔子（Confucius）的民本、基督（Christ）的博爱与'苦力'（Coolies）的尊严在他身上熔铸为'不做官、不发财、把终身献给劳苦的大众'的职业化使命观，教育与信仰不分家。其二，诊断先于开方——先承认'中国的问题不是挨骂而是未诊断'，用统计调查（定县七年内完成县情普查、土地、人口、健康基线）把'愚贫弱私'四大病从道德指控转为可测量的诊断框架，再对症配'四大教育'，每一病一个教育子系统、每一子系统自带课程与组织。其三，需要即课程——'最大的学习动力来自需要'：教材从农民的生活里来（千字课选字按《通用字表》频率统计），技术推广用'表证农家'（示范户）而非说教，让农民在解决自家问题时完成学习；教育不再是灌注而是触发。其四，整体系统观——单点教育必然失败，因为愚贫弱私互相锁死；四大教育必须经'三大方式'（学校式、社会式、家庭式）同时入村，最后收束为'县政改革'，把实验成果固化为制度。其五，知识分子的逆向流动——'博士下乡'不是慈善下乡而是'与农民同住同行'的方法论要求：你不懂农民的语言与账本，任何方案都是空谈；'回到民间去'是知识生产方式的改造。其六，低成本可复制——一切设计都按'资源穷尽条件'优化：六百字、导生制、村保健员，使成果能脱离天才创始人而迁移到任何穷县乃至任何穷国——这是定县方法能在菲律宾复活的根本原因。

cross_references.description_zh: 晏阳初自称思想底座的第一个C是孔子：'民为邦本，本固邦宁'是他全部工作的宪法。但转译是工程性的：孔子的'民本'是把人民当作政治合法性的来源与教化对象（'富之教之'），晏阳初把'教之'改写为一套可测量、可复制、可移交的操作体系——诊断（愚贫弱私）、处方（四大教育）、给药途径（三大方式）、疗程（县政固化）。孔子的'有教无类'在晏这里变成'有教无弃'：不是收弟子，而是消灭'类'本身（文盲）。他与儒家最终的分野在'谁来教'：儒家依赖君子人格，晏设计导生制与表证农家，让'民'自己成为教者——这是民本走向民主的工程桥梁。对照链：M-YC-002（诊断先于开方）× 孔子'视其所以，观其所由'——同一'因材施教'前提的宏观化；M-YC-007（知识人逆向流动）× 孔子'学而优则仕'的反命题——士的方向从向上一格改为向下一层。

cross_references.relation_type: 教育哲学的师承与倒置：从'教育即生活'到'生活即教材'
cross_references.description_zh: 晏阳初在耶鲁受杜威实用主义教育哲学浸润，但其关系是倒置的继承：杜威说'教育即生活、学校即社会'，是从学校出发把生活引进来；晏阳初说'需要即课程、社会即教室'，是从生活出发把学校送出去。杜威的'做中学'以中产儿童的经验为默认起点，晏把它推到极端贫困条件下：当学习者连课本都买不起时，'做中学'必须同时是'做中学的经济学'——六百字、导生制、示范户都是这一约束下的解。杜威视民主为教育的目的，晏补上被杜威体系忽略的一环：民主的前提是识字与生计，'四大教育'是民主的先修课。对照链：M-YC-004（需要即课程）× 杜威'教育即经验的改造'——同一经验主义命题在极端资源约束下的重写；M-YC-009（低成本可复制）× 杜威实验学校——理想学校的两种成本账。

modes.name_en: Discovering the Dignity of the Coolie: Recasting the Educable Subject
modes.definition_zh: 一切平民教育的起点不是方法而是对象的重估：晏阳初1918年在法国华工营教识字，本打算做慈善性的'帮写信、译新闻'，却在华工身上看到'苦力'的二重性——他们不缺智力，只缺机会；不缺道德，只缺被承认的地位。他把这一发现固化为信条：'苦力'不是需要怜悯的可怜人，而是被制度剥夺了识字机会的潜在新民；人民不是教育的客体而是主体，'民为邦本，本固邦宁'。方法论签名有三：其一，先验地假定学习者有能力——华工能在课余学会写信记账，证明文盲是机会问题而非智力问题；其二，从服务者转为同工——他拒绝居高临下的施舍姿态，主张'和农民同吃同住同劳动'，教育者与被教育者在人格上平等；其三，教育目的的公民化——识字不是终点，'除文盲、作新民'才是终点，识字是恢复人做公民之资格的第一步。这一模式把'教育谁'的问题从恩赐逻辑翻转为权利逻辑，是此后一切方法的正当性来源。
modes.definition_en: The starting point of mass education is not method but the revaluation of its subject. In 1918, running a literacy class for Chinese laborers in a YMCA camp in France, James Yen had come to do charity — write letters, explain newspapers — and instead discovered the duality of the 'coolie': what he lacked was not intelligence but opportunity; not morality but recognized standing. Yen fixed the discovery as a credo: the coolie is not an object of pity but a citizen-in-waiting stripped of literacy by circumstance; the people are not the object of education but its subject — 'the people are the foundation of the state; when the foundation is firm, the state is tranquil.' Three disciplines define the mode. First, presume capacity a priori: laborers learned to write and keep accounts in their off-hours, proving illiteracy is a problem of opportunity, not intelligence. Second, convert server into co-worker: he refused the posture of top-down charity, insisting on eating, living, and laboring with the peasants — educator and educated as equals in dignity. Third, civilize the aim of literacy: reading is not the terminus; 'eliminate illiteracy, make new citizens' is — literacy is the first step in restoring a person's qualification for citizenship. The mode flips 'whom we educate' from a logic of benefaction to a logic of rights, supplying the legitimacy for every method that follows.
modes.source_chapter: 晏阳初《平民教育与乡村建设运动》文集中关于法国华工营的回忆（'苦力的发现'）；《驻法华工周报》创办缘起；1943年受奖词与晚年口述（《晏阳初传》，吴相湘）
process_zh: 从'服务任务'里找认知反例：做任何面向弱势群体的项目时，先记录与预设相反的观察——对方做到了'理论上不可能'的事（华工自学的信、账），逐一归档
把'例外'重估为'证据'：追问每个反例——它推翻的是对方的'不能'，还是制度的'不给'？把结论写成对象观宣言（如'文盲是机会问题'）
重建教育者姿态：把项目语言从'救助/帮扶/施舍'改写为'同工/授权/共建'，并落实为空间与生活的共处规则（同吃同住同劳动）
把对象观写进目的链：任何课程设计必须能回答'这一步如何恢复学习者的公民资格'——识字、算账、卫生、议事皆是资格建设的阶梯
process_en: Hunt counterexamples inside the service assignment: in any project serving a disadvantaged group, log observations that contradict your premises — the other side did what was 'theoretically impossible' (letters and accounts self-taught), file each one.

Revalue the exception into evidence: for each counterexample ask — does it refute their 'cannot,' or the system's 'will not'? Write the conclusion as a subject-credo (e.g., 'illiteracy is a problem of opportunity').
Rebuild the educator's posture: rewrite project language from 'aid/help/charity' to 'co-worker/empower/co-build,' and enforce it as rules of shared life (eat, live, labor together).

Wire the subject-credo into the aims chain: every curriculum step must answer 'how does this restore the learner's qualification for citizenship' — literacy, numeracy, hygiene, deliberation are rungs of that ladder.
representative_cases_zh: 1918-1919年法国布朗华工营：晏阳初原只办代写书信处，华工的求知欲远超预期——有人攒钱买字典、有人课后互相教学；他由此创办《驻法华工周报》并开识字班，'苦力的发现'在此完成，归国志业由此定盘
1922年长沙扫盲试验：以'平民是可教的'为前提设计三日招生，得1900人——城市平民（并非只剩农家）同样被'文盲'标签掩盖了求知能力；试验成功直接催生全国平教运动
反面警示：同时期一些'慈善办学'把贫民儿童当作需要驯化的对象，教认字同时教服从，毕业即止——对象观错了，方法越精越有害；晏阳初明确批评'把平民当白纸'的教育是'白纸教育'，学完即忘因为学的是别人的字而非自己的需要
representative_cases_en: The Boulogne labor camp, France, 1918-1919: Yen ran a letter-writing desk, but the laborers' hunger to learn outran it — some saved to buy dictionaries, others taught classmates after class. He founded the camp weekly and literacy classes; the 'discovery of the coolie' completed here set the course of his life.

Changsha literacy experiment, 1922: designing three-day enrollment on the premise that the common people are educable, he enrolled 1,900 — urban plebeians, no less than peasants, had been hidden behind the 'illiterate' label; the trial's success ignited the national movement.

Cautionary counterexample: contemporary 'charity schools' treated poor children as objects to be tamed — teaching letters alongside obedience, stopping at graduation. With the wrong subject-credo, the finer the method, the worse the harm; Yen explicitly attacked education that 'treats the people as blank paper' as 'blank-paper education,' forgotten at once because it taught another's words, not one's own needs.
modern_applications_zh: 公益产品设计：先做'能力假设审计'——受助群体已自发解决了哪些问题？把自发方案升级为正式产品，而非从零灌输
企业管理一线员工：把'一线没能力'的抱怨改写为'流程没给机会'的诊断——改善提案制、一线带教制的正当性来自对象重估
数字普惠服务：老年人/低学历用户的'不会用'先假定为界面问题而非能力问题，用真实使用观察重估后再设计
教育培训招生：不按'基础差'筛选，先测'学过之后想解决什么问题'，以需要定班级而非以分数定去留
modern_applications_en: Product design for public good: run a capacity-assumption audit — which problems has the served group already solved informally? Upgrade their improvisations into products instead of instilling from zero.

Managing frontline workers: rewrite 'the frontline lacks ability' as a diagnosis 'the process grants no opportunity' — suggestion schemes and peer-teaching draw their legitimacy from subject-revaluation.
Digital inclusion: treat older or low-literacy users' 'can't use it' first as an interface problem, not a capacity problem; redesign after observing real use.
Program admissions: do not screen out by 'weak basics'; first ask what problem the learner wants to solve after learning — let need set the class, not scores.

modes.key_quote_en: The coolie is not born ignorant — he has never been given a chance. I discovered a new continent, and it was not overseas; it was in the coolie himself.

modes.name_en: The Four Diagnoses: Naming Ignorance, Poverty, Weakness, Selfishness
modes.definition_zh: 晏阳初的方法论枢纽是先诊断后开方：拒绝把'农村落后'当作笼统道德问题，而把它分解为四个可分别命名、分别测量、分别处方的根本病症——愚（缺乏知识，最大多数人的最大病）、贫（缺乏生计）、弱（缺乏健康）、私（缺乏公德与组织）。诊断的纪律在于：一是有限清单——从千头万绪的农村问题中'认定四种问题是比较基本的'，宁缺勿滥，每个病必须有对应的可操作处方才算数；二是病因互锁观——四大病不是并列而是互相锁死（愚使贫固、贫使弱深、弱私互滋），单点治疗必然复发，这为'整体系统'埋下伏笔；三是处方匹配律——每种病配一种教育：文艺教育攻愚、生计教育治贫、卫生教育扶弱、公民教育克私，诊断与处方一一对应，不留'诉诸道德'的模糊地带。这一模式把社会改造从'哀民生之多艰'的抒情传统，改写为'命名-测量-配药'的公共卫生传统：问题先被命名，然后才可能被解决。
modes.definition_en: The hinge of James Yen's method is to diagnose before prescribing: he refused to treat 'rural backwardness' as a vague moral problem and decomposed it into four separately nameable, measurable, and treatable root conditions — ignorance (lack of knowledge, the greatest ailment of the greatest number), poverty (lack of livelihood), weakness (lack of health), and selfishness (lack of public morality and organization). The diagnostic disciplines are three. First, a closed list: out of the thousand tangled problems of the countryside he 'identified four as basic' — fewer rather than more, and each earns its place only if an operable prescription exists for it. Second, interlock view: the four are not parallel but mutually locking — ignorance cements poverty, poverty deepens weakness, weakness and selfishness feed each other — so single-point treatment must relapse, which foreshadows the systemic design. Third, the prescription-matching law: each ailment gets one education — literary education attacks ignorance, livelihood education cures poverty, health education buttresses weakness, civic education overcomes selfishness — diagnosis and prescription in one-to-one correspondence, leaving no vague zone of 'appeals to morality.' The mode rewrites social reform from the lyric tradition of 'alas for the people's hardship' into the public-health tradition of name-measure-prescribe: a problem must be named before it can be solved.
modes.source_chapter: 《晏阳初全集》中《定县社会概况调查》导言与'四大教育'系列演讲（1930s）；中华平民教育促进会《工作报告》；'农村运动的使命'（1934）
process_zh: 拒绝总括性抱怨：把'整体不行/素质差'类的判断列为无效输入，强制改写为'具体谁、具体缺什么、具体在哪一环节失败'
做有限清单筛选：列出全部观察到的病症，用两条标准淘汰——'是否基本'（其余问题是否多由它派生）与'是否有可操作处方'，收敛到极少数根诊断
画病因互锁图：对入选诊断逐一标注其加剧其他诊断的路径，确认哪些必须并行处理、哪些可分阶段——防止以为治好一个其余自愈
逐病配处方并留档：每一诊断绑定一种干预、一套测量指标与一个评估时点，形成'诊断-处方-指标'三联卡，日后复盘按卡对照
process_en: Refuse blanket complaints: classify verdicts like 'the whole thing is broken / they are just low-quality' as invalid input, and force the rewrite into 'who specifically, lacking what specifically, failing at which step specifically.'

Filter into a closed list: enumerate all observed ailments and screen with two tests — is it basic (do other problems derive from it?) and does an operable prescription exist? — collapsing into a handful of root diagnoses.

Draw the interlock map: for each admitted diagnosis, mark the paths by which it aggravates the others, and decide which must run in parallel and which can be staged — never assume curing one cures the rest.

Match prescriptions and file them: bind each diagnosis to one intervention, one set of metrics, one evaluation point — a diagnosis-prescription-metric card to be checked against at every retrospective.
representative_cases_zh: 1930年代初定县调查：《定县社会概况调查》（李景汉主持）以县为单位完成人口、土地、教育、卫生、经济基线普查——'愚贫弱私'由此从印象变成数据：文盲率、死亡率、人均耕地、村公所账目各有实数可指
四大教育与病的对应：定县的文艺教育（千字课、农民戏剧、杂志）对口愚；生计教育（合作杜、改良猪种棉种、表证农家）对口贫；保健院-村保健员三级卫生制度对口弱；公民教育（村自治训练、公民道德课）对口私——每一处方都能说出'治哪个病'
反面警示：同期不少乡村运动（如某些义赈与'道德重整'路线）跳过诊断直接开方——要么只赈粮（治贫不管愚，明年照旧），要么只讲修身（治私不管贫，饿着讲不来公德）；晏阳初批评这类方案'头痛医头'且互相抵消，证明诊断不齐处方的行动必然碎片化
representative_cases_en: The Ding Xian survey, early 1930s: led by Li Jinghan, a county-wide baseline census of population, land, education, health, and economy — turning the four diagnoses from impressions into data: illiteracy, mortality, per-capita arable land, and village-account integrity each had real numbers.

The fourfold match: Ding Xian's literary education (thousand-character lessons, peasant theater, magazines) aimed at ignorance; livelihood education (cooperatives, improved swine and cotton, demonstration farmhouses) at poverty; a three-tier health system (health academy, station, village health workers) at weakness; civic education (village self-government training, civics lessons) at selfishness — every prescription could name the ailment it treated.

Cautionary counterexample: other rural movements of the era skipped diagnosis and prescribed directly — grain relief alone (curing poverty while ignoring ignorance, same field next year) or moral exhortation alone (curing selfishness while ignoring poverty — no civic virtue on an empty stomach). Yen attacked such schemes as head-pain-head medicine that cancel each other: action without matched diagnosis is condemned to fragmentation.
modern_applications_zh: 组织绩效诊断：把'团队不行'分解为能力（愚）、激励（贫）、健康度（弱）、协作（私）四维，分别配培训、薪酬、负荷管理、流程规则——禁止用单一'团建'包治四病
公共政策设计：扶贫先建基线调查（教育、收入、健康、治理各建指标），避免'给钱解决一切'的单一处方
个人成长复盘：把'我不够好'改写为四维自查——认知、现金流、精力、关系公德，各配一个具体处方而非泛泛'努力'
产品增长瓶颈分析：'增长不行'拆为认知度、付费力、留存体验、推荐意愿四诊断，分别对应获客、定价、体验、裂变处方
modern_applications_en: Organizational diagnosis: decompose 'the team isn't working' into capability (ignorance), incentives (poverty), health/load (weakness), and collaboration (selfishness) — match training, pay, load management, and process rules; ban 'one team-building retreat' as a universal cure.
Public policy: build baseline surveys (education, income, health, governance indicators) before anti-poverty programs, avoiding the single prescription 'just give money.'
Personal retrospectives: rewrite 'I'm not good enough' as a four-axis self-check — cognition, cash flow, energy, relational ethics — each with one concrete prescription, not a vague 'work harder.'

Growth bottleneck analysis: split 'growth is stalling' into awareness, ability-to-pay, retention experience, and referral willingness — four diagnoses matched to acquisition, pricing, experience, and virality prescriptions.

modes.key_quote_zh: 中国农村的问题千头万绪，但我们认定愚、贫、弱、私四种是比较基本的——问题被正确命名之时，才是它可能被解决之始。
modes.key_quote_en: The problems of rural China are a thousand tangled threads; but we identified four — ignorance, poverty, weakness, selfishness — as basic. A problem becomes solvable only when it has been rightly named.

modes.name_en: Fourfold Education: One Prescription per Ailment
modes.definition_zh: 把诊断翻译为可执行课程系统的工程：晏阳初为四大病各设一条教育线——文艺教育攻愚（识字、科学常识、农民戏剧）、生计教育治贫（农业改良、合作经济、手工业技艺）、卫生教育扶弱（创建县-乡-村三级保健制度，村保健员用最廉价的人完成最基础的防治）、公民教育克私（村自治、公民表证、公共事务训练）。方法论的签名有四：其一，处方与诊断严格对位——每条教育线都源于一个诊断，评估也按该诊断的指标结算，不容'教育=读书'的语义偷换；其二，教育内容的本地生产——千字课选字来自平民书信与账簿的频率统计，改良棉种猪种先在本地试验田与表证农家试养试种，课程是为本地问题定制的，不是通用教材的下放；其三，每线自带组织载体——识字有平民学校，生计有合作社，卫生有保健院，公民有村自治会议，内容与载体同时设计；其四，四线并行且互补——针对病因互锁，四大教育同时进村而非按顺序排队，任何一线单飞都会被其他病症拖回原点。这一模式是'教育'一词的工程化重定义：教育不再等于学校，而是针对社会疾病的复合处方系统。
modes.definition_en: The engineering that translates diagnosis into an executable curriculum system. James Yen built one education line per ailment: literary education attacks ignorance (literacy, basic science, peasant theater); livelihood education cures poverty (agricultural improvement, cooperatives, craft skills); health education buttresses weakness (a county-township-village three-tier health system, with village health workers doing the most fundamental prevention at the cheapest cost); civic education overcomes selfishness (village self-government, civic demonstration, training in public affairs). Four disciplines define the mode. First, strict prescription-diagnosis correspondence: every education line derives from one diagnosis and is settled against that diagnosis's metrics — no semantic laundering of 'education = reading books.' Second, local production of content: the thousand-character lessons chose characters from frequency counts of commoners' letters and account books; improved cotton and swine were trialed in local fields and demonstration farmhouses — curricula tailored to local problems, not dispatches of universal textbooks. Third, each line carries its own organizational carrier: literacy has the mass school, livelihood the cooperative, health the clinic, civic life the village assembly — content and carrier designed together. Fourth, the four lines run in parallel and complementarily: because the ailments interlock, all four enter the village simultaneously, not in a queue; any line flown alone is dragged back to the origin by the untreated rest. The mode redefines 'education' as engineering: education is no longer the school but a compound prescription system against social disease.
modes.source_chapter: 中华平民教育促进会《定县实验工作报告》（1930s）；《晏阳初全集》'四大教育'专章；翟城村实验纪要与《民间》周刊相关社论
process_zh: 从诊断卡直接派生教育线：每个已命名病症开一条线，写明'本线治哪个病、以何指标结算'，无诊断不开线——防止课程库存膨胀
内容本地化生产：教材素材取自目标人群的真实文本与真实账目（信件、市集价目、农事历），技术方案先在本地做对照试验再入课程
内容与载体同步设计：每条线落地时同时确定其组织形式（校/社/院/会）与人事（谁来教、谁来管、钱从哪来），课程没有载体不算设计完成
四线并行进村并互查：排定四大教育的同时入村时序与接口（识字课顺便教卫生常识、合作社顺便训练议事），每季按各自指标互查，防止某线被其他病症拖垮
process_en: Derive education lines straight from the diagnosis cards: one line per named ailment, stating 'which ailment this treats and by which metric it settles' — no new line without a diagnosis, preventing curriculum inventory bloat.

Produce content locally: source materials from the target population's real texts and accounts (letters, market prices, farming calendars); trial any technical package in local controlled plots before it enters the curriculum.

Design carrier with content: when a line lands, fix its organizational form (school/cooperative/clinic/assembly) and its staffing (who teaches, who administers, where money comes from) — a curriculum without a carrier is not a finished design.

Send the four lines in parallel with cross-checks: schedule all four lines' village entry together and define their interfaces (literacy lessons carry hygiene basics; cooperatives double as deliberation training); audit each line quarterly against its own metric so none is dragged down by untreated ailments.
representative_cases_zh: 文艺教育定县落地：除千字课外创办《农民》周报与农民戏剧运动（熊佛西主持的话剧让不识字的农民用身体'读'剧本），'攻愚'不限于文字——这是处方对位纪律下对'病重程度'的适配
生计教育的表证农家：改良猪种与棉种不靠行政摊派，而是选示范户试养试种，邻里看收成后自愿跟从——处方自带'眼见为实'的传播机制，推广成本极低
反面警示：定县卫生教育最初的'县保健院'按城市医院规格建设，费用高昂而村户利用率低；后改为'村保健员'（每村一人、训数周、配急救箱）才真正下沉——证明处方若不按病人所在层级设计，再正确的药也送不到病灶；晏阳初由此把'卫生教育'重写为三级递送系统
representative_cases_en: Literary education at Ding Xian: beyond the thousand-character lessons, a weekly Peasant paper and a peasant-theater movement (Xiong Foxi's spoken drama let illiterate farmers 'read' scripts with their bodies) — 'attacking ignorance' adapted to severity, under the correspondence discipline.

Demonstration farmhouses in livelihood education: improved swine and cotton strains were not administratively parceled out but trialed by selected model households; neighbors followed voluntarily after seeing yields — the prescription carried its own 'seeing is believing' transmission mechanism at minimal cost.

Cautionary counterexample: Ding Xian's first county health academy was built to urban-hospital spec — expensive and barely used by villagers. The redesign — one village health worker per village, weeks of training, a first-aid kit — finally sank the line to the ailment's level: a prescription not engineered at the patient's tier never reaches the lesion. Yen rewrote 'health education' as a three-tier delivery system.
modern_applications_zh: 企业培训体系：按'能力短板诊断'开设课程线（谈判弱开谈判线、数据弱开数据线），每线配指标与载体（课+练习场+复盘会），禁止采购一堆通用网课算作培训
区域产业帮扶：一条链配一个处方包——良种+合作社+乡镇技术站+订单渠道同时落地，不做只送种子不管销路的单点帮扶
学校课后服务：'作业难'配辅导线、'视力差'配户外线、'社交弱'配社团线，三线并行并互查执行率
个人技能投资：为每个职业瓶颈配'内容+组织载体'（课程+社群+输出场合），只买课不入社群者按'未完成处方'处理
modern_applications_en: Corporate training: open course lines per diagnosed capability gap (a negotiation line for negotiation weakness, a data line for data weakness), each with metrics and a carrier (course + practice arena + retro) — buying a bundle of generic e-courses does not count as training.

Regional industry support: one value chain, one prescription package — improved inputs + cooperative + township tech station + order channels landing together; no seed-only aid that ignores market access.
After-school programs: a tutoring line for homework struggle, an outdoor line for eyesight, a club line for weak socialization — run in parallel and cross-audited for execution.

Personal skill investment: pair every career bottleneck with content plus carrier (course + community + a venue to ship work); buying a course without joining the community counts as an unfilled prescription.

modes.key_quote_zh: 四大教育不是四门课，而是四张处方——文艺攻愚、生计治贫、卫生扶弱、公民克私，处方与病一一对应，缺一则病不愈。
modes.key_quote_en: The fourfold education is not four courses but four prescriptions — literary for ignorance, livelihood for poverty, health for weakness, civic for selfishness — matched one-to-one; omit one and no ailment heals.

modes.name_en: Need as Curriculum: Teaching Through the Learner's Own Problem
modes.definition_zh: 晏阳初教育哲学的核心命题：'人民最大的学习动力来自需要'——不是先设计'该学什么'再说服人来学，而是先找到学习者当下正疼的问题，把教学内容变成解决它的工具。方法论签名有四：其一，从真实文本倒推课程——《平民千字课》的选字不来自经典字表，而来自对平民书信、账目、契约的频率统计：农民最先要写的字，就是最先教的字；其二，问题先于学科——教水利不先讲水力学而先解决当地灌溉纠纷，教卫生不先讲生理学而先处理眼下流行的时疫，学科体系在需要之后才展开；其三，成果即时可见——学习周期设计为'学完即用、用了即见'（学了记账本周就用上），用可见收益维持学习动机，对抗文盲学习最大的敌人——放弃；其四，教者也是求需者——平教会要求工作人员先做村情调查、先学会农民语言，'需要'由学习者定义而非专家定义，教材是调查的产出而非书房的产出。这一模式与杜威'教育即生活'同源而方向相反：杜威把生活引进学校，晏阳初把学校送进生活。
modes.definition_en: The core proposition of James Yen's educational philosophy: 'the greatest motivation for learning comes from need' — do not design 'what should be learned' and then persuade people to come; find the problem that hurts the learner now, and turn the teaching content into the tool that solves it. Four disciplines define the mode. First, back-derive the curriculum from real texts: the Thousand Character Lessons chose characters not from a classical list but from frequency counts of commoners' letters, accounts, and contracts — the characters farmers most needed to write were the first taught. Second, the problem precedes the discipline: teach irrigation not by beginning with hydraulics but by settling the village's actual water dispute; teach hygiene not by beginning with physiology but by handling the epidemic at hand; the disciplinary system unfolds only after the need. Third, results must be instantly visible: learning cycles are designed as 'learn it, use it the same week, see it work' (bookkeeping applied that very week) — visible payoff sustains motivation against the illiterate learner's greatest enemy, quitting. Fourth, the teacher is also a need-seeker: Mass Education Association staff were required to survey village conditions and learn the peasants' language first — 'need' is defined by the learner, not the expert; textbooks are the output of fieldwork, not of the study. The mode shares a root with Dewey's 'education is life' but runs the opposite way: Dewey brought life into the school; Yen sent the school into life.
modes.source_chapter: 晏阳初《平民教育概论》（1920s）'需要即动力'节；《平民千字课》编选凡例；平教会《乡村教育讲义》关于'以需要编课程'的论述
process_zh: 先做'疼痛清单'调查：进入任何教学/培训场景，先收集学习者本周真实发生的问题（要写的信、要算的账、要防的病），按频次排序
从问题倒推内容：把频次最高的问题转成第一个课程模块，教材素材直接取自真实问题文本；学科体系以脚注而非正文的方式后置
设计'本周见效'回路：每个模块必须绑定一个本周可完成的实际任务，学习评估以'任务是否完成'而非'测试分'结算
专家退居翻译席：领域专家的职责是把'学习者的需要'翻译为内容，而不是把'学科的结构'强加给学习者——每版教材须标注它来自哪次调查
process_en: Run a pain-list survey first: entering any teaching or training setting, collect the learner's real problems this week (letters to write, accounts to settle, epidemics to prevent), ranked by frequency.

Back-derive content from problems: turn the highest-frequency problems into the first modules, sourcing materials directly from the real problem texts; disciplinary systems enter later, as footnotes rather than body text.
Design a 'works this week' loop: every module binds to a real task completable this week; assessment settles on 'was the task done,' not the quiz score.

Seat the expert in the translator's chair: the expert's job is to translate the learner's need into content, not to impose the discipline's structure on the learner — every textbook edition must cite the survey it came from.
representative_cases_zh: 《平民千字课》六百字方案：选字组统计平民书信与账簿用字，得出'识六百字即可写常见信、记常用账'的最小集，四个月卒业——文盲的学习负担被压到'本周写信'这一真实需要所需的最小规模
定县生计教育的'账本课'：不教经济学原理，先教农民记自家收支流水账，两周后农民自己发现'钱漏在哪里'——会计知识以'找漏'的需要为入口，合作社入社率随之上升
反面警示：早期某些平校照搬城市夜校课本，讲'电灯电话、火车轮船'的都市课文，农民学完无物可用、到课率骤降——内容若不锚定学习者的需要，教得越好流失越快；平教会随即全面改写教材，把每一课都落到'本村的物、本村的账'
representative_cases_en: The 600-character plan: the selection team counted characters in commoners' letters and account books and derived the minimal set — '600 characters suffice to write common letters and keep common accounts,' graduable in four months — compressing the illiterate learner's burden to the minimum that the real need 'write a letter this week' requires.

The ledger lesson in livelihood education: no principles of economics; first teach farmers to record their own household cash flows. Within two weeks farmers discovered for themselves where the money leaked — bookkeeping entered through the need 'find the leak,' and cooperative enrollment rose.

Cautionary counterexample: some early mass schools copied urban night-school textbooks full of 'electric lights, telephones, trains and steamers'; farmers finished with nothing to use and attendance collapsed. Content not anchored to the learner's need sheds learners faster the better it is taught; the Association rewrote every lesson onto 'this village's objects, this village's accounts.'
modern_applications_zh: 企业内训：开课前先采集学员'本周真实工作难题'，把首批模块直接对着这些难题设计；评估以难题是否解决结算
少儿编程/成人技能教育：第一个项目必须做出学习者自己要用的东西（家庭账本、报名表单），不以语法体系开头
健康科普：不从器官解剖讲起，从'本周流感怎么应对'讲起，学科图谱后置为延伸阅读
知识付费课程设计：以用户'要交付的事'（面试、报销、汇报）为模块入口，每模块配一个当天可用的模板
modern_applications_en: Corporate training: before the course, collect trainees' real problems of this week and design the first modules straight against them; settle assessment on whether the problems got solved.
Coding for kids / adult skills: the first project must produce something the learner will actually use (a household ledger, a signup form) — never open with syntax systems.
Health communication: do not start with anatomy; start with 'how to handle this week's flu,' parking the disciplinary map as further reading.
Course design for paid content: open each module from the thing the user must deliver (an interview, an expense report, a briefing) with a same-day usable template.

modes.key_quote_zh: 人民不是不愿学习，而是没有人为他们的需要编过课本——最大的学习动力来自需要，课程应当从农民疼痛的地方开讲。
modes.key_quote_en: The people are not unwilling to learn — no one ever wrote a textbook for their needs. The greatest motivation for learning comes from need: the curriculum should begin where the farmer hurts.

modes.name_en: Doctors to the Villages: Co-residence as Epistemic Method
modes.definition_zh: 把知识分子的站位本身设计为方法：1929年晏阳初举家从北平迁入河北定县，随行的有数十位留学归来的博士、教授与工程师（'博士下乡'一词由此而来）。这不是姿态性支农，而是认识论要求——他判断一切农村改造失败的先例都败在'城里的专家用想象代表农民'，因此立规：方案制定者必须与方案承受者同住、同行、同劳动，先获得'农民的语言、账本与日程'，再谈改造。方法论签名有四：其一，身体在场优先于文献研究——定县七年先做全域社会调查再动工，调查员驻村而非巡回；其二，同住是数据质量要求而非道德姿态——只有住下来才能看到账本、听到闲话、赶上农时，'需要'才能被真实采集；其三，专家身份的降格与转用——博士下乡不带'指导者'头衔入村，其专业知识改用于'把农民的需要翻译成技术方案'；其四，双向改造——晏阳初明言平教会同仁也在此过程中被改造（去掉都市习气、获得对民情的直觉），知识生产是双向的化学反应用于人身上。这一模式是当代'参与式设计''田野调查'与'用户研究'在1920年代的前置原型。
modes.definition_en: Designing the intellectual's position itself as method. In 1929 James Yen moved his entire household from Beiping into Ding Xian, Hebei, followed by dozens of foreign-trained PhDs, professors, and engineers — the origin of the phrase 'doctors to the villages.' This was not token support of the countryside but an epistemic requirement: he judged that every prior rural-reform failure died of 'city experts standing in for peasants by imagination,' and therefore ruled that the maker of a plan must live, work, and labor alongside those who bear it, acquiring 'the peasant's language, ledger, and calendar' before any reform is discussed. Four disciplines define the mode. First, embodied presence outranks documentary study: Ding Xian's seven years began with a full-domain social survey before construction, with surveyors resident in villages rather than touring. Second, co-residence is a data-quality requirement, not a moral pose: only by living there can you see the account books, hear the gossip, catch the farming season — only then can 'need' be collected as it is. Third, demotion and repurposing of expert identity: PhDs entered villages without the title of 'advisor'; their expertise was repurposed to translate the peasants' needs into technical packages. Fourth, two-way transformation: Yen said plainly that his colleagues were themselves transformed in the process — shedding urban habits, gaining an intuition for local conditions; knowledge production is a two-way chemistry applied to persons. The mode is the 1920s precursor of participatory design, ethnography, and user research.
modes.source_chapter: 晏阳初《'博士下乡'十年》相关回忆与演讲；《晏阳初全集》'我们为什么要到乡间去'；定县实验参与者的《民间》周刊纪实；吴相湘《晏阳初传》相关章节
process_zh: 把'谁来做'写成规程：项目启动前立规——方案制定者必须驻点（同吃同住同劳动），不得以视察、挂职、远程汇报替代；驻点期写入岗位描述
先住后问：驻点第一阶段禁止提方案，任务限定为学语言、记日程、抄账本、随农时劳动——采集'生活底本'而非'访谈样本'
专家转译而非指导：每个技术方案须标注'它回应的村民原话'与'村民参与的环节'，无法标注的方案退回重做
建立双向复盘：每季除评估项目指标外，另评'专家自身被改造清单'——哪些预设被村民推翻、哪些直觉来自驻村——防止知识生产退回单向输送
process_en: Codify 'who does it': before launch, rule that plan-makers must be resident (sharing meals, lodging, labor), with no substitution by inspection tours, nominal postings, or remote reporting; residency time goes into the job description.

Live first, ask later: in the first stage of residency, proposing solutions is banned; the task list is language, calendars, ledgers, and labor along the farming season — collecting the 'substrate of life,' not 'interview samples.'
Experts translate, never direct: every technical package must cite the villager's own words it answers and the steps where villagers participated; packages that cannot cite both are sent back.

Run two-way retrospectives: each quarter, besides project metrics, audit the 'transformation list of the experts themselves' — which assumptions the villagers overturned, which intuitions residency bought — so knowledge production never slides back to one-way delivery.
representative_cases_zh: 1929年举家迁定县：晏阳初放弃北平的教职与舒适生活，全家迁入翟城村，一批博士（如陈志潜、冯锐、熊佛西、瞿菊农等）陆续携家随迁——'博士下乡'成为全国性新闻，也在知识界引发'改造乡村还是被乡村改造'的持续辩论
李景汉的《定县社会概况调查》：调查团队驻村数年，产出中国第一部以县为单位的全面社会调查（人口、土地、赋税、教育、卫生、信仰），成为四大教育处方的数据底本——先住后问的典范产出
反面警示：定县也暴露'同住'的限度——不少同仁始终难脱'绅士'做派，村民仍称'晏先生'而非同工；平教会内部刊物承认'同吃同住'多做到了形式，'同想'远未达成；晏阳初由此把'双向改造'从口号升级为季度考核项，承认方法无法自动生效，必须持续审计
representative_cases_en: The 1929 move: Yen gave up a Beiping professorship and comfort, moving his whole family to Zhaicheng village; a cohort of PhDs — Chen Zhiqian, Feng Rui, Xiong Foxi, Qu Junong — followed with their households. 'Doctors to the villages' became national news and touched off a lasting debate: reform the village, or be reformed by it.

Li Jinghan's social survey of Ding Xian: a resident team over years produced China's first county-scale comprehensive social survey (population, land, taxation, education, health, belief) — the data substrate of the fourfold prescriptions, and the model output of 'live first, ask later.'

Cautionary counterexample: Ding Xian also exposed the limit of co-residence — many associates never shed the gentry manner; villagers still said 'Mr. Yan' rather than 'co-worker.' The Association's own bulletin admitted 'sharing meals and lodging' was achieved in form while 'sharing thought' was not; Yen thereupon upgraded 'two-way transformation' from slogan to quarterly audit, conceding the method does not run on autopilot.
modern_applications_zh: 产品经理驻场：做B端/县域产品前，产品负责人须在客户现场驻点数周跟单、记账、值班，需求文档须引用现场原话
乡村振兴/公益项目：禁止'飞地式'项目组——驻村时长、与村民同餐次数写进团队考核，方案评审要求出示村民参与证据
用户研究纪律：研究者在实验室'访谈用户'之外，必须完成与用户同工况的实操（陪跑一天客服、跟一天外卖员），否则结论降级为假设
咨询行业：诊断报告须标注顾问在客户现场的驻场时长与一手观察条数，无驻场的建议按二手推断标记
modern_applications_en: Product managers on site: before building B2B or county-market products, the product lead must embed at the customer site for weeks — shadowing orders, bookkeeping, desk shifts; requirement docs must quote verbatim field language.
Rural development and NGOs: ban 'enclave' project teams — residency days and shared meals with villagers go into team KPIs; proposals must show evidence of villager participation to pass review.

User-research discipline: beyond lab interviews, the researcher must complete real work under the user's conditions (a day on the support desk, a day with a courier) — else findings are downgraded to hypotheses.
Consulting: a diagnosis must state the consultant's on-site residency time and count of first-hand observations; advice without residency is flagged as second-hand inference.

modes.key_quote_zh: 要想化农民，须先农民化——你不知道农民的语言、账本与农时，你的一切方案都是城里人的一厢情愿。
modes.key_quote_en: To transform the peasant you must first be peasantized: without the peasant's language, ledger, and farming calendar, every plan of yours is the city man's wishful thinking.

modes.name_en: Three Approaches: School, Society, Family as Concurrent Channels
modes.definition_zh: 解决'课堂覆盖不了全社会'的组织设计：晏阳初发现单一学校式教育在成年文盲面前失效（农民不可能脱产上学），于是把教育拆为三条并行给药途径——学校式（平民学校，面向青少年与失学儿童）、社会式（读书亭、演讲比赛、农民戏剧、壁报，面向全体村民的公共空间）、家庭式（家庭联合会，以家庭为单位互教互促，长者授课幼者、幼者反哺长者）。方法论签名有四：其一，渠道按生活半径设计而非按行政半径——学校入校龄、社会式入集市与农闲、家庭式入灶间，三条渠道分别嵌在受众已有的生活结构里，零新增时间成本；其二，同一内容三渠道广播——千字课内容同时以课本、壁报、戏剧、家庭游戏出现，反复曝光代替集中灌输；其三，导生制（小先生）作为放大器——学完的教没学的，儿童回家教父母，教育在人际网络中自我复制，教师缺口由学习者补足；其四，全渠道统一进度与指标——三条渠道为一个病（如愚）的同一张诊断卡服务，按统一的识字率指标结算，防止渠道间抢功推诿。这一模式把'教育组织'从单一建筑扩展为一个社会的全部交往空间，是渠道思维的先声。
modes.definition_en: An organizational design for the fact that no classroom can cover a whole society. James Yen found that school-only education fails before the adult illiterate (a farmer cannot leave the fields to attend), and split delivery into three concurrent channels: the school approach (mass schools for youth and out-of-school children), the social approach (reading booths, speech contests, peasant theater, wall newspapers — public space for all villagers), and the family approach (family federations where households teach each other, elder instructing junior and junior feeding back to elder). Four disciplines define the mode. First, channels follow life-radii, not administrative radii: school enters school age, the social approach enters markets and slack seasons, the family approach enters the kitchen — each embedded in structures the audience already inhabits, at zero added time cost. Second, one content, three-channel broadcast: the thousand-character lessons appear simultaneously as textbook, wall news, drama, and family game; repeated exposure replaces concentrated instruction. Third, the student-teacher system (little teachers) as amplifier: those who have learned teach those who have not — children teach parents at home, and education self-replicates through the interpersonal network, filling the teacher gap with learners. Fourth, unified progress and metrics across channels: the three channels serve one diagnosis card (say, ignorance) and settle against one literacy metric, so channels cannot rival or shift blame. The mode expands 'educational organization' from a single building to every space where a society interacts — an early exercise in channel thinking.
modes.source_chapter: 中华平民教育促进会《定县实验工作报告》'三大方式'章；《平民学校·社会式·家庭式实施大纲》；《晏阳初全集》论'教育组织'诸篇
process_zh: 按受众生活半径铺渠道：为目标人群画一日生活圈（校龄、集市、灶间、农闲），每圈落一条教育渠道——不新增任何'专程学习时间'
同一内容多格式改写：把核心内容同时制作成课本、公共空间物料（壁报、戏剧、比赛）、家庭互动件（亲子互教卡），统一话术与进度
启用导生放大：结业者授'导生'职，一人带数人，教学业绩计入其升级条件——把学习者网络变成师资网络
全渠道一张诊断卡结算：三渠道共背同一指标（如识字率、卫生行为率），季度联合复盘，禁止渠道间数据打架或互相甩锅
process_en: Lay channels along the audience's life-radius: map the target group's daily circle (school age, market, kitchen, slack season) and drop one education channel into each — adding zero 'special study time.'

Rewrite one content into many formats: produce the core content simultaneously as textbook, public-space material (wall news, drama, contests), and family interactive pieces (parent-child teaching cards), with unified phrasing and pacing.

Amplify with student-teachers: graduates are commissioned as 'little teachers,' each taking several learners, their teaching record counting toward advancement — turning the learner network into the teacher network.

Settle on one diagnosis card across channels: the three channels jointly own one metric (say, literacy rate or hygiene-behavior rate), with joint quarterly reviews — no clashing data, no blame-shifting between channels.
representative_cases_zh: 定县学校式：全县设平民学校与初级平校，采用'导生制'——学过的学生分片带教未入学者，教师编制远小于学生规模；平校毕业者再入'高级平校'形成阶梯
社会式的农民戏剧与壁报：熊佛西的定县农民戏剧让全村既是观众又是演员，剧词即识字课的复现；村口壁报每周更新、集市设读书亭——教育嵌入公共生活的每一个聚集点
反面警示：早期家庭式推进不力——以'家长会'名义召集，到场者几乎全是祖辈而父母缺席，互教设计落空；平教会改以'家庭联合会'重组（以户为单位、幼者为小先生登记造册），并把识字任务编入家事分工，家庭式到课与互教率才真正起量——证明渠道必须嵌进家庭既有结构，而非另造一个'开会的家'
representative_cases_en: The school approach at Ding Xian: countywide mass schools with the student-teacher system — graduates taught unschooled peers by district, with staff far below student scale; a ladder of advanced mass schools above them.

Peasant theater and wall news in the social approach: Xiong Foxi's village drama made the whole village audience and cast at once, its lines reinforcing the literacy lessons; wall newspapers refreshed weekly and reading booths at market days — education embedded at every gathering point of public life.

Cautionary counterexample: the family approach first stalled — summoned as 'parents' meetings,' attendees were almost all grandparents, parents absent, the mutual-teaching design empty. Reorganized as 'family federations' (per household, children registered as little teachers, literacy tasks woven into housework division), attendance and mutual-teaching rates finally took off — proof that a channel must embed in the family's existing structure, not create another 'meeting-shaped family.'
modern_applications_zh: 企业学习平台：同一内容按生活半径分发——通勤音频（入班车上）、工位卡片（入车间）、家庭任务（亲子共学），而非单一网课库
公共卫生宣传：同一健康内容做诊所海报（入就医动线）、集市快板（入赶集）、家庭洗手卡（入灶间），三渠道同一指标考核行为改变率
社区治理：议事规则培训不另办班——学校公民课、社区宣传栏、家庭议事卡三线同讲一套规则
产品用户教育：新手引导按用户动线铺（开屏、社群、客服话术三渠道），统一考核功能采用率
modern_applications_en: Corporate learning platforms: distribute one body of content along the life-radius — commute audio (into the shuttle), workstation cards (into the shop floor), family tasks (into the home) — rather than a single course library.

Public-health campaigns: one health message as clinic posters (into the visit flow), market-day jingles (into the fair), family handwashing cards (into the kitchen) — three channels scored on one behavior-change metric.
Community governance: teach deliberation rules without a special class — school civics, community boards, and family deliberation cards carrying the same rules.
Product user education: lay onboarding along the user's journey (splash screen, community, support scripts — three channels) with unified feature-adoption metrics.

modes.key_quote_en: The school occupies only one corner of a farmer's life: education must enter the market, the kitchen, and the stage — three channels giving the medicine at once, leaving illiteracy nowhere to hide.

modes.name_zh: 知识人使命感职业化法
modes.name_en: Professionalizing Vocation: Knowledge Workers on a Lifetime Mission
modes.definition_zh: 回答'凭什么让精英长期服务底层'的机制设计：晏阳初对平教会同仁的要求不是短期奉献而是职业化的终身志业——'不做官、不发财，把终身献给劳苦的大众'。他知道单靠道德感召必然枯竭，于是把使命感做成制度：其一，使命遴选制——入会同仁须认同'民为邦本'纲领并通过乡村驻点试用期，淘汰观光者；其二，低薪有尊严的职业结构——平教会提供低于都市但体面的薪酬、住房与子女教育，使同仁'过得下去而不求发家'；其三，事业阶梯内置——在平教会内部建立研究-实验-推广的学术晋升线（发表、驻县主持、育才院教职），使下乡不等于学术自杀；其四，荣誉外部补给——以国际声誉（1943十大伟人、国际演讲）补偿物质清贫，把'清苦'转化为'被世界承认'。这一模式把'知识分子服务人民'从口号改写为可持续的人力资源系统：使命感不是燃烧自己，而是设计一条既能安身又能立命的职业轨道。
modes.definition_en: A mechanism design answering 'why would elites serve the grassroots for the long term.' James Yen demanded of his colleagues not short-term sacrifice but a professionalized lifetime vocation: 'no official post, no fortune — a lifetime given to the toiling masses.' Knowing moral appeal alone must run dry, he engineered the mission as institution. First, mission-based selection: members had to embrace the 'people as foundation' creed and pass a village-residency probation — sightseers were filtered out. Second, a modest-but-dignified career structure: the Association paid below metropolitan rates but decent, with housing and children's schooling — livable without striving for wealth. Third, an in-house ladder of advancement: a research-experiment-extension academic track within the Association (publications, county residencies in charge, chairs at the training institute), so going rural did not mean academic suicide. Fourth, external honor supply: international recognition (the 1943 'ten most revolutionary contributors,' global lectures) compensated material austerity, converting 'hardship' into 'recognized by the world.' The mode rewrites 'intellectuals serve the people' from slogan to sustainable human-resource system: vocation is not burning yourself but designing a career track where one can both make a living and make a life.
modes.source_chapter: 晏阳初对平教会同仁的多次演讲（'不做官、不发财'誓词，1920s-1930s）；《晏阳初全集》论'人才'与'同志'诸篇；中国乡村建设育才院（1940）章程；吴相湘《晏阳初传》人事章
process_zh: 把'使命'写成入伙合同：纲领（为谁、不为什么）与试用期任务（驻点）前置到遴选环节，用真实工作筛人而非靠宣誓
设计'过得下去的清贫'：薪酬可低于市场但必须覆盖体面生活（住房、子女教育、医疗），并公示薪资逻辑——清贫是选择而非剥削
给志业修内部阶梯：在机构内设研究职级、驻县主持、教学职等晋升线与署名权，让服务底层与学术/职业发展同向
运营外部荣誉：主动对接国际平台、出版英文成果、申报奖项，把机构声誉变成成员的荣誉补给——确保物质清贫者有精神复利
process_en: Write the mission into the joining contract: put the creed (for whom, and for the sake of what) and probation tasks (residency) at selection — screen people with real work, not oaths.
Design 'livable austerity': pay below market but covering a decent life (housing, children's education, healthcare), with the salary logic published — austerity as a choice, not exploitation.

Build the in-house ladder: research ranks, county-lead posts, teaching chairs, and attribution rights inside the institution, so serving the grassroots and academic or career growth point the same way.

Operate external honor: engage international platforms, publish in English, apply for awards — convert institutional reputation into members' honor supply, so the materially austere accrue spiritual compounding.
representative_cases_zh: 平教会的人事稳定：定县十年间数百名博士、工程师、医生以职业身份长期驻县（非志愿轮换），离职率低于同期都市学术机构——低薪体面+内部阶梯+国际声誉的组合使'下乡'成为可预期的人生方案
中国乡村建设育才院（1940）：晏阳初在璧山创办，把一线经验转为正式研究生培养，平教会骨干任教授——'下乡'者获得教学与研究职级的正式通路，机构人才再生产闭环
反面警示：定县末期经费断供时（抗战军兴、政府拨付停摆），'荣誉补给'无法兑付房租，部分骨干被迫离开转任公职——证明使命感轨道仍需财务底盘：一旦'体面的低薪'降为'不体面的无薪'，遴选再严、阶梯再全也留不住人；晏阳初晚年把'可持续的经费结构'列为平教运动第一教训
representative_cases_en: Personnel stability at the Association: across Ding Xian's decade, hundreds of PhDs, engineers, and doctors stayed resident on professional contracts (not volunteer rotation), attrition below contemporary metropolitan academia — modest decency plus in-house ladder plus international honor made 'going rural' a plannable life.

The National Rural Reconstruction Training Institute (1940): founded at Bishan, converting field experience into formal graduate training with Association stalwarts as professors — a formal pathway to teaching and research ranks, closing the talent-reproduction loop.

Cautionary counterexample: when funding collapsed in the late Ding Xian years (war with Japan, government appropriations stopped), the 'honor supply' could not pay the rent and some stalwarts left for official posts — proof that the vocation track still needs a financial chassis: once 'decent austerity' becomes 'indecent penury,' no selection or ladder retains people. In old age Yen ranked 'a sustainable funding structure' as the movement's first lesson.
modern_applications_zh: 公益机构薪酬设计：薪酬公开为'低于商业但可安家'，配合职级、署名、国际会议通路——用制度而非鸡汤留人
开源社区/科研团队：核心维护者给予正式职位、晋升线与外部曝光（大会讲席、奖项提名），使命感与职业安全并行
艰苦地区人才项目：驻县/驻边服务计入职称评审与晋升必要条件，把'下沉'变成上升的台阶而非牺牲
创始团队激励：早期低薪承诺必须配套股权、生活补贴与荣誉叙事的兑现节奏，防止'用情怀发不出工资'
modern_applications_en: Nonprofit compensation: publish pay as 'below commercial but able to support a household,' paired with ranks, attribution, and conference pathways — retain people with institutions, not slogans.
Open-source and research teams: give core maintainers formal positions, promotion tracks, and external visibility (keynotes, award nominations) — vocation and job security running together.
Talent programs for hardship postings: rural or border service as a required step in title review and promotion — descent becomes a stair up, not a sacrifice.
Startup teams: early low-pay promises must be paired with equity, living stipends, and a redemption schedule for the honor narrative — never pay salaries with sentiment alone.

modes.key_quote_zh: 不做官，不发财，把终身献给劳苦的大众——使命感不能只靠燃烧，要把它设计成一条既能安身、又能立命的职业轨道。
modes.key_quote_en: No official post, no fortune — a lifetime given to the toiling masses. Vocation cannot run on burning alone: design it as a career track where one can both make a living and make a life.

modes.name_en: County-Government Reform: Freezing Experiments into Institutions
modes.definition_zh: 解决'实验成果随人亡政息'的制度工程：晏阳初判断，定县实验若只停留在平民学校与合作社，政权一换就会归零，因此把实验的政治目标定为'县'——以县为单位把民间实验固化为政府制度。方法论签名有四：其一，实验-建制两段论——民间机构（平教会）负责研究与试验，产出经验包；政府（县政建设研究院/实验县公署）负责把它升格为预算、编制与法规，两阶段职能分立、接口明确；其二，以'县'为制度单位——县既是最小完整行政单元又是最小完整社会单元，制度在此规模上可被真实运转、可被测量、可被复制到他县；其三，公务员换血实验——1930年代晏阳初任河北省县政建设研究院院长并主持实验县，裁撤冗吏、公开招考，以'学者县政'替换旧胥吏，把'人的改造'写进制度改造；其四，退出路线预写——实验设计时就约定移交条件（师资本地化、经费来源本地税源、村组织自治化），防止实验机构永久替代政府。这一模式回答了所有社会实验的终极难题：如何让'成功'不依赖创始人的肉身与续命。
modes.definition_en: The institutional engineering that answers 'how can an experiment outlive its founder.' James Yen judged that if the Ding Xian experiment stopped at mass schools and cooperatives, one change of regime would zero it out; he therefore set the political aim at the county — freezing civil experiments into government institutions, with the county as the unit. Four disciplines define the mode. First, a two-stage experiment-institution split: the civil body (the Mass Education Association) does research and trials, producing experience packages; the government (county construction institute / experimental county office) promotes them into budgets, staffing, and statute — separate functions with a defined interface. Second, the county as the institutional unit: a county is both the smallest complete administrative unit and the smallest complete social unit — at this scale institutions can truly run, be measured, and be copied to other counties. Third, personnel-replacement experiments: in the 1930s, as head of the Hebei county-government construction institute and director of an experimental county, Yen cut redundant clerks and held open examinations, replacing the old clerk class with 'scholar magistrates' — writing 'the transformation of persons' into institutional reform. Fourth, a pre-written exit route: experiments stipulated handover conditions at design time (localized teachers, funding from local taxes, self-governing village organizations) so the experimental body never permanently substitutes for government. The mode answers the terminal question of every social experiment: how to make success independent of the founder's body and lifespan.
modes.source_chapter: 晏阳初任河北省县政建设研究院院长时期文件（1935-1937）；《晏阳初全集》'县政改革'与'实验县'诸篇；定县实验县公署工作报告；'乡村建设实验的检讨'（1937）
process_zh: 实验设计即写移交条款：启动任何试点时先约定'成功后移交给谁、靠什么预算活、何时退出'——把退出条件当作验收标准的一部分
选定最小完整单元做建制试验：制度试验不在村庄层（易孤岛化）也不在省级（难验证），而在县级完整行政-社会单元上跑通
民研官制的接口管理：民间研究机构产出'经验包'（教材、编制、流程、成本表），政府按包立法拨款——接口文档化，防止实验机构越权行政或政府敷衍收编
人随制度走：建制方案须含人事方案——公开考选替换旧吏、培训新任者、预留旧人转型通道，否则新制度会被旧人架空
process_en: Write handover clauses at experiment design: when launching any pilot, first stipulate 'after success, handed to whom, alive on what budget, exiting when' — exit conditions as part of the acceptance criteria.

Choose the smallest complete unit for institutional trials: not the village (easily an island) nor the province (hard to verify) but the county — a complete administrative-social unit where the system can truly run.

Manage the civil-research/government-institution interface: the civil body ships 'experience packages' (textbooks, staffing, processes, cost tables); government legislates and funds by package — documented interfaces prevent the NGO from usurping administration or the state from token absorption.

Personnel moves with institutions: institutionalization must include a staffing plan — open examinations replacing old clerks, training new appointees, a transition lane for the old — or the new institution will be hollowed out by the old hands.
representative_cases_zh: 河北县政建设研究院与实验县（1935-）：晏阳初以平教会经验包为基础主持定县等实验县改制——平民学校纳入县教育预算、村保健员编入县卫生体系、合作社与县银行对接，民间十年试验在县级完成制度升格
'学者县政'人事试验：实验县公开招考县长与科员、裁撤大量旧胥吏，新任者多受乡村教育训练——把平教会'人的改造'逻辑注入官僚系统，被视为民国县政史上罕见的制度化换血
反面警示：1937年日军占领定县，实验县制度随军事崩溃一夜归零——暴露'制度固化'仍受制于主权环境：晏阳初未能在实验设计里预写'战时接管'条款；他战后转战国际（菲律宾IIRR）正是吸取此训——把制度移植到政治环境更稳定的载体，并以教材与学院而非官僚任命作为固化介质
representative_cases_en: The Hebei county-government institute and experimental counties (1935-): on the Association's experience packages, Yen oversaw county restructuring — mass schools into county education budgets, village health workers into the county health system, cooperatives linked to the county bank — the civil decade's institutional upgrade at the county level.

The 'scholar magistrate' personnel trial: experimental counties held open examinations for magistrates and clerks, cut large numbers of old functionaries, and staffed with the rural-educated — injecting the Association's 'transformation of persons' logic into the bureaucracy, a rare institutional blood-change in Republican county history.

Cautionary counterexample: Japanese occupation of Ding Xian in 1937 zeroed the experimental institutions overnight — exposing that institutional freezing remains hostage to the sovereign environment: no wartime-trusteeship clause had been pre-written. Yen's postwar turn to the international stage (IIRR in the Philippines) drew exactly this lesson — transplant institutions onto more stable political carriers, with textbooks and an academy, not bureaucratic appointment, as the freezing medium.
modern_applications_zh: 企业创新试点：任何试点立项即写'若成功转入常规业务由哪个部门按什么预算接管'——防止创新部门变成永久飞地或成果随试点解散蒸发
政府购买服务/PPP：民研官制接口——社会组织的'服务包'（内容、编制、成本表）转为政府年度预算科目，退出条款前置
开源项目治理：项目从'作者主导'转向'基金会托管'时预写移交条款（商标、CI、资金），作者淡出不带走基础设施
国际发展项目：援助项目立项即规划本地税源接续与人员编制移交，避免'援助一停服务即亡'
modern_applications_en: Corporate innovation pilots: every pilot is chartered with 'if successful, which department takes over on what budget' — preventing innovation teams from becoming permanent enclaves or results evaporating at pilot wind-down.

Government purchased services / PPP: the civil-research, state-institution interface — an NGO's 'service package' (content, staffing, cost table) converted into annual budget lines, with exit clauses up front.
Open-source governance: when a project moves from author-led to foundation custody, pre-write the handover (trademark, CI, funding) so the founder's fade-out does not take the infrastructure along.
International development: at project inception, plan local tax-source succession and staffing handover — so services do not die the day aid stops.

modes.key_quote_en: An experiment that cannot be upgraded into institutions lives only as long as its founder: the county is the smallest complete unit where institutions can truly live — turn folk experience into the state's skeleton here.

modes.name_en: Designing for Low-Cost Replicability: Engineering for the Poor Man's Budget
modes.definition_zh: 把'可复制'当作设计约束而非事后目标：晏阳初的一切发明都在'资源穷尽条件'下优化——目标人群是全中国最穷的人，因此任何依赖高成本投入的方案自动作废。方法论签名有四：其一，最小可行剂量——千字课压到六百字、四个月，卫生压到'每村一个训数周的保健员加一个急救箱'，教学压到导生制（教师成本近零）；每个处方都先问'最穷的县付得起多少'，再倒推方案复杂度上限；其二，本地材料与本地人力优先——教材用本地土纸土话、教员从本地结业者中产生、卫生员从本村选训，几乎不进口任何稀缺资源；其三，传播机制内嵌——表证农家（示范户）让成果'眼见为实'地自我传播，不加推广预算；其四，以标准化包与培训学院固化——把定县经验打包为教材、规程与乡村建设育才院课程，使复制不依赖创始人或原班人马（后来IIRR在菲律宾以同一课程培训数十国学员即验证）。这一模式与'补贴依赖型'公益形成对照：不是花钱把样板做亮，而是把成本压到最穷的买单者能持续支付的水平——复制力是穷国的规模定律。
modes.definition_en: Treating replicability as a design constraint, not an afterthought. Everything James Yen invented was optimized under conditions of exhausted resources — the target population was among the poorest in China, so any plan dependent on high-cost inputs was void by construction. Four disciplines define the mode. First, the minimum viable dose: the literacy course compressed to 600 characters over four months; health compressed to 'one village health worker trained in weeks plus a first-aid kit per village'; teaching compressed to the student-teacher system (teacher cost near zero). Every prescription first asks 'what can the poorest county afford,' then back-derives the ceiling of plan complexity. Second, local materials and local people first: textbooks on local paper in local speech, teachers raised from local graduates, health workers selected and trained from the village itself — almost no scarce resources imported. Third, transmission built in: demonstration farmhouses let results spread by 'seeing is believing,' with no promotion budget. Fourth, freeze into standardized packages and a training academy: Ding Xian's experience packaged as textbooks, protocols, and Rural Reconstruction Institute curricula, so replication depends on neither the founder nor the original team (later verified when IIRR in the Philippines trained participants from dozens of countries with the same courses). The mode stands opposite subsidy-dependent philanthropy: not spending to make the showcase gleam, but pressing costs to the level the poorest payer can sustain — replicability is the scaling law of the poor.
modes.source_chapter: 《晏阳初全集》论'推广'与'表证'诸篇；平教会《农村建设实施要项》；陈志潜《定县卫生实验》成本核算章；国际乡村改造学院（IIRR）课程体系档案
process_zh: 先定'最穷买单者预算'：启动设计前确认未来付费/维持主体的支付能力上限（最穷县的财政、农户的现金结余），一切方案规模以此为硬顶
做减法到最小可行剂量：对每个处方问'砍到多少仍能解决病痛'——字数、课时、人员、器材逐项压减，复杂度只保留'治病'必需的部分
用本地资源替代稀缺输入：逐项审查方案对稀缺资源（专家、进口设备、外部资金）的依赖，逐项替换为本地材料与本地人力，替换不了的重新设计
把成果封成'包'并建学院：将验证过的方案固化为标准化教材、规程与培训课程，复制单位是'包'而非'人'——并为包建立版本管理，随各地反馈迭代
process_en: Fix the poorest payer's budget first: before design, confirm the payment ceiling of the future sustaining body (the poorest county's fiscal capacity, a household's cash surplus) — the hard cap on every plan's scale.

Subtract to the minimum viable dose: for each prescription ask 'how much can be cut and still cure' — characters, class hours, personnel, equipment pressed down, keeping only the complexity the cure requires.

Substitute local resources for scarce inputs: audit every dependence on scarce resources (experts, imported equipment, external funds) and replace item by item with local materials and people; what cannot be replaced forces a redesign.

Freeze results into packages and an academy: solidify validated plans into standardized textbooks, protocols, and training courses — the unit of replication is the package, not the person — with version management iterating on field feedback.
representative_cases_zh: 陈志潜的定县卫生制度：拒绝按城市医院标准建体系，设计'村保健员（训数周、配急救箱）—乡保健所—县保健院'三级递送，人均年度卫生成本压至几角钱——成为后来发展中国家初级卫生保健（PHC）的世界级先例，WHO'2000年人人享有卫生保健'的阿拉木图宣言亦溯源于此类实验
导生制的成本归零：定县平校师生比远超常规学校仍维持运转，因为'教师'大半由上周的学员免费充任——人力成本从预算科目变成学习者的副产品
反面警示：定县个别项目曾按'模范'标准建设（如早期县保健院、某些示范村），投入高而难以为他县复制，日后被晏阳初自己列入检讨——'样板做亮'消耗了可用于'普通可行'的资源，背离穷国规模定律；此后平教会将'他县付得起'列为方案验收硬指标
representative_cases_en: Chen Zhiqian's Ding Xian health system: refusing urban-hospital standards, he designed the three-tier delivery 'village health worker (weeks of training, a first-aid kit) — township station — county academy,' pushing per-capita annual health cost to a few cents — a world-class precedent for primary health care in developing countries, later cited in the lineage of Alma-Ata's 'Health for All.'

The student-teacher system's zero-cost staffing: Ding Xian's mass schools ran with student-teacher ratios far beyond normal schools because 'teachers' were largely last week's learners, unpaid — labor cost converted from a budget line into a by-product of learning.

Cautionary counterexample: some Ding Xian projects were built to 'model' standards — the early county health academy, certain showcase villages — costly and unreplicable by other counties; Yen later listed them in his own self-critique: 'making the showcase gleam' consumed resources owed to 'ordinary feasibility,' betraying the poor's scaling law. The Association then made 'affordable to another county' a hard acceptance criterion.
modern_applications_zh: 公益产品设计：立项先算'地方政府/农户后续年度自付成本'，超限即削减方案复杂度——拒绝依赖捐赠维持的'样板工程'
连锁与加盟扩张：把单店模型压到'最穷候选加盟商也开得起'，用本地人力与本地供应链替代总部稀缺资源，复制单位是手册而非创始人
企业内训体系：课程设计为内训师（上期学员）可讲授的标准化包，培训成本随规模递减而非递增
发展中国家/下沉市场产品：硬件与流量成本按当地收入倒数设计，功能只保留解决核心痛点的最小集
modern_applications_en: Product design for the public good: at inception, compute the sustaining body's future annual self-paid cost (local government, households); if over budget, cut plan complexity — no showcase depending on donors.

Franchise expansion: press the unit model to 'affordable for the poorest qualified franchisee,' replacing scarce headquarters resources with local people and supply chains; the replication unit is the manual, not the founder.
Corporate training systems: design courses as standardized packages deliverable by internal trainers (last cohort's learners), so training cost falls rather than rises with scale.
Products for developing or down-market segments: hardware and traffic costs designed against the inverse of local income, keeping only the minimal feature set that cures the core pain.

陈志潜（低成本卫生体系的世界级设计者）
傅葆琛（教材本地化与推广执行者）

modes.key_quote_zh: 方案若要让最穷的人也能买单，就必须在最穷的预算上设计——复制力不是推广出来的，是从第一笔账就算出来的。
modes.key_quote_en: If the poorest must pay, design on the poorest budget: replicability is not promoted into a project — it is computed from the very first entry of the ledger.

modes.name_en: The Ding Xian Loop: Field-Test, Audit, Revise, Re-test
modes.definition_zh: 晏阳初把整个平教运动设计为一个持续迭代的循环系统而非一次性工程：定县不是'推广样板'而是'全国实验室'——每一处方在定县试点，试点结果每季按诊断卡指标审计，审计失败即修订处方再试，验证后的经验才进入'经验包'向他县与国际推广。方法论签名有四：其一，指标先行——每条教育线开工前先写定指标与结算时点（识字率、入社率、卫生行为率、村自治运转率），审计以数据而非汇报为准；其二，容错入预算——平教会年度报告公开列明失败项（哪些村平校到课率低、哪些改良种不适应本地），把'试错成本'当作运动的正常开支而非丑闻；其三，自我批判制度化——晏阳初多次公开检讨（'四大教育未完成''同住而未同想''样板工程之弊'），并把检讨写进后续设计约束；其四，纵向纵深与横向迁移并举——同一处方先在定县迭代到成熟（纵向），再以'包+学院'形式横向迁移，迁移后仍保留当地迭代分支（菲律宾IIRR课程随各国反馈分叉）。这一模式使定县实验区别于一次性的政治工程：它是一个有版本管理的百年项目，至今仍在IIRR延续。
modes.definition_en: James Yen designed the whole movement as a continuously iterating loop rather than a one-shot project: Ding Xian was not a 'model for rollout' but the national laboratory — every prescription was piloted there, audited quarterly against its diagnosis card's metrics, revised on failure, and only after validation entered the 'experience package' for promotion to other counties and abroad. Four disciplines define the mode. First, metrics before work: before any education line starts, its metrics and settlement points are written (literacy rate, cooperative enrollment, hygiene-behavior rate, village-self-government function), and audit runs on data, not reports. Second, error tolerance in the budget: the Association's annual reports publicly listed failures (which villages' schools had low attendance, which improved seeds failed locally) — trial-and-error cost treated as the movement's normal expenditure, not a scandal. Third, institutionalized self-critique: Yen repeatedly reviewed himself in public ('the fourfold education unfinished,' 'living together but not thinking together,' 'the showcase-project vice') and wrote the critiques into the constraints of subsequent designs. Fourth, vertical depth and horizontal transfer together: one prescription iterated to maturity at Ding Xian (vertical), then moved horizontally as 'package plus academy,' with local iteration branches retained after transfer (IIRR curricula forking on each country's feedback). The mode sets the Ding Xian experiment apart from one-off political engineering: it is a century project with version management, still running at IIRR today.
modes.source_chapter: 中华平民教育促进会历年《工作报告》与《民间》周刊检讨文章；晏阳初'乡村建设实验的检讨'（1937）与历次演讲中的自我批评；国际乡村改造学院历年课程修订档案
process_zh: 处方开工前写定'验收卡'：指标、数据来源、结算时点三方签字确认——无验收卡的试点不得开工
按季审计并公示失败：审计以基线数据对照结算，失败项与成功项同表公示——把失败清单当作运动年报的固定栏目
检讨回写设计约束：每次公开检讨必须转化为下轮设计的硬约束（如'他县付得起''同想考核'），由专人跟踪约束的执行
迁移保留迭代分支：经验包外移时禁止'原样照搬'——接收地建立本地指标与修订权，包的版本随各地反馈持续分叉演进
process_en: Write the acceptance card before a prescription starts: metrics, data source, and settlement point signed by three parties — no pilot launches without one.
Audit quarterly and publish failures: audit settles against baseline data; failures and successes on the same public table — the failure list a fixed column of the annual report.

Rewrite critiques as design constraints: every public self-critique must convert into hard constraints for the next design round ('affordable to another county,' 'shared-thought audits'), with an owner tracking enforcement.

Keep iteration branches on transfer: experience packages may not be copied verbatim — receiving sites establish local metrics and revision rights, and package versions keep forking with local feedback.
representative_cases_zh: 平教会年报的失败栏：定县十年工作报告定期列明未达指标项目（某些村到课率低、家庭式早期失败、若干改良品种水土不服）并附原因分析——这一'公开失败'的纪律在同期运动中罕见，是'全国实验室'定位的证据
1937年'乡村建设实验的检讨'：晏阳初系统总结定县未竟之处（四大教育只完成了文艺与公民两线的深化、县政改革被战争打断、'博士下乡'的同住未达同想），并把每一条写为后续育才院与IIRR的设计约束
反面警示：定县后期因战争与经费危机，季度审计名存实亡、指标让位于'汇报体'——迭代循环一旦停摆，即使先前处方正确也会在环境变化中失准（日军占领后整套体系一夜失灵）；IIRR时代重新恢复版本管理与本地修订权，才使定县方法在数十年后仍在数十国保持生命力——证明复盘法不是项目的一部分，而是项目本身的心跳
representative_cases_en: The failure column of the Association's annual reports: over Ding Xian's decade, work reports regularly listed items that missed their metrics (low attendance in certain villages, the family approach's early failure, improved seeds that failed in local soil) with cause analysis — a rare discipline of 'public failure' in the movements of the day, the proof of the 'national laboratory' stance.

The 1937 'review of rural reconstruction experiments': Yen systematically summed up what Ding Xian had not finished (only the literary and civic lines deeply developed, county reform broken by war, co-residence without shared thought) and wrote each item as a binding constraint for the later Training Institute and IIRR.

Cautionary counterexample: in Ding Xian's late years, war and funding crisis hollowed out the quarterly audits and metrics gave way to 'report-writing prose' — once the loop stalls, even correct prescriptions lose calibration as the environment shifts (the whole system failed overnight under occupation). IIRR restored version management and local revision rights, keeping the Ding Xian method alive across decades and dozens of countries — proof that the retrospective loop is not a part of the project but the project's heartbeat.
modern_applications_zh: 企业战略复盘：每个战略假设开工前写'验收卡'（指标+时点+数据源），季度公开失败清单，检讨回写为下轮约束——禁止'汇报体复盘'
敏捷组织：季度OKR结算以数据为准，失败项同表公示并转化为流程约束变更单，由专人跟踪落地
公益项目治理：资助协议内置'失败公示条款'与'修订权归一线'条款，防止社会组织报喜不报忧
产品迭代：A/B实验失败结果全公司公示并归档为设计约束（如'该文案在下沉市场流失率高'），版本化沉淀
modern_applications_en: Corporate strategy retrospectives: every strategic hypothesis gets an acceptance card (metrics, timing, data source) before work starts, quarterly public failure lists, critiques rewritten as next-round constraints — no 'report-prose' retrospectives.
Agile organizations: quarterly OKR settlement on data, failures on the same table, converted into process-constraint change tickets with named owners.
NGO governance: funding agreements embed 'public failure clauses' and 'revision rights with the field' — so grantees cannot report only good news.
Product iteration: failed A/B results published company-wide and archived as design constraints ('this copy churns in down-market segments'), kept versioned.

modes.key_quote_zh: 定县不是样板间，是全国的实验室——处方要试、要审、要改，失败要公开入账：复盘不是项目的一部分，是项目本身的心跳。
modes.key_quote_en: Ding Xian is not a model home but the nation's laboratory: prescriptions must be tried, audited, revised, and failures publicly booked — the retrospective loop is not a part of the project; it is the project's heartbeat.
